## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / CI / repository maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass or are not applicable
- [ ] New/changed behavior has appropriate tests
- [ ] Authorization and cross-user access were considered
- [ ] Error handling and observability were considered
- [ ] Migrations/backward compatibility were considered
- [ ] Documentation was updated where needed
- [ ] ADR/architecture diagrams were updated if an accepted design changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private career data, or production data are included
- [ ] External vacancy/recruiter/web content is treated as untrusted input

## Notes / risks

List known risks, follow-up work, or explicitly accepted limitations.
